name: Radar (Large)
description: This sensor outputs the distance and relative angles to a detected object within its range and field of view using radio waves. This sensor uniquely allows the changing of it's pitch direction. (Range : 20000) (Max FOV : 0.250)
shortDescription: A medium range, highly configurable Radar that returns detailed information about a detected object within its view.

logicNodes.label: Target Found
logicNodes.description: Returns if an object has been detected.

logicNodes.label: FOV
logicNodes.description: The sensor's yaw and pitch field of view in turns from 0.01 to 0.125.

logicNodes.label: Facing Yaw
logicNodes.description: The sensor's yaw direction in turns from -0.5 to 0.5.

logicNodes.label: Facing Pitch
logicNodes.description: The sensor's pitch direction in turns from -0.25 to 0.25.

logicNodes.label: Target Distance
logicNodes.description: The distance to the target in meters.

logicNodes.label: Signal Strength
logicNodes.description: The strength of the returned signal.

logicNodes.label: Elevation Angle
logicNodes.description: The pitch angle between the sensor and the target in turns.

logicNodes.label: Azimuth Angle
logicNodes.description: The yaw angle between the sensor and the target in turns.
